# Fused Turbo INT8 + Mystic V2

Source: https://note.com/synth_brain/n/naecc37369fde
See the repository README for model paths and custom-node dependencies.

Fast4: 4 steps at 0.2 MP; optional upscale branch bypassed.
HiRes: 4 steps, learned 2x latent upscale, then 4 steps at denoise 0.35.
res_multistep/simple; sigma shift 12/3; 4B ClipProj; Spectrum blend 0.3.
Additional Spectrum offline replay and attention compilation are disabled.
Upload reference images and fill Anim Prompt Input before using the template.
Audio references are optional. Duration defaults to 5 seconds (124 aligned frames).
No separate Turbo LoRA or RIFE interpolation.
Generation has not been run; timing and motion quality are not benchmarked.
